name: Highly Qualified Specialist status (ВКС, Vysokokvalifitsirovanny Spetsialist)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a documented salary of at least RUB 750,000 per quarter (roughly RUB 250,000/month), under Art. 13.2 of Federal Law No. 115-FZ.
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a salary at or above the current quarterly threshold with the sponsoring employer.

requirement_groups.name: Reduced-threshold track (research, teaching, SEZ, accredited IT companies)

requirements.blocker_text: A lower threshold of RUB 83,500/month applies specifically to HQS hired for scientific or teaching work, employees of accredited IT companies, and workers in industrial-production, tourist-recreational, or port special economic zones; a further-reduced RUB 58,500/month threshold applies to residents of technology-innovation special economic zones specifically.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm the role falls within one of these designated lower-threshold categories.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract meeting the applicable salary threshold
Employer's HQS petition to the MVD (no formal skills certification required -- the employer self-assesses qualification)
Proof the role does not fall within Art. 14's prohibited categories (religious activity, retail sale of consumer goods, among others)

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years, renewable indefinitely; the residence permit itself has been issued for an indefinite term since November 2019

sources.title: Confidence Group -- Разрешение на работу для ВКС, citing Art. 13.2 of Federal Law No. 115-FZ and the RUB 750,000/quarter standard threshold
Kdelo -- Высококвалифицированный специалист: пошаговое оформление ВКС, citing Art. 13.2(1) of Federal Law No. 115-FZ for the reduced RUB 83,500/month and RUB 58,500/month thresholds

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. STRUCTURAL FINDING: HQS is Russia's fastest and most favourable general work-based settlement route by a wide margin -- unlike ru_work_visa_permit and ru_patent_work, HQS status leads directly to permanent residence (VNZh) with no prior RVP stage at all (pr_after_months = 0), and the residence permit itself has been issued for an indefinite term since a November 2019 reform, rather than requiring periodic renewal. Family members (spouse, children, parents, grandparents) included in an HQS petition face no salary threshold of their own and get simplified employment authorisation -- a genuine structural benefit worth surfacing. Classified as work_independent rather than work_sponsored because HQS status is fundamentally built around the individual's own high-value negotiating position and self-assessed qualification (no formal certification or exam is required; the employer simply attests to the applicant's expertise) rather than a quota-gated employer-sponsorship process -- a defensible but genuinely debatable categorisation, since an employer petition is still technically required to initiate the status. LIVE PENDING REFORM, flagged rather than silently ignored: a government bill submitted to the State Duma on 21 February 2026 proposes raising HQS salary thresholds and tightening several other requirements -- as of this research pass the bill had not yet been passed into law, so the RUB 750,000/quarter and RUB 83,500/RUB 58,500 monthly figures documented here remain the current legal thresholds, but applicants and employers should check for updates given the bill's active status. Even HQS hiring remains subject to Art. 14 prohibited-activity restrictions (religious/proselytising work, retail sale of consumer goods including pharmaceuticals, among others) and sector-specific industry quotas by OKVED code -- HQS status is not a blanket exemption from all Russian labour-migration restrictions, only from the ordinary quota and permit process most other foreign workers face.
